description: Change what this computer lends and when. Only the fields given change. Turning lending on lets other people's jobs run here, sandboxed. Confirm with the person first.

answerWaitMinutes.description: How long to wait for answers from the network's AI models (default 10 minutes)

cacheCopies.description: How many public repos of others to keep a copy of

containers.description: Run container jobs (needs Docker or Apple Container)

gpu.description: GPU class lent, by video memory

hours.description: Lend only between these hours, e.g. [22, 8]; null = any time

idleMinutes.description: Lend only after this many minutes without keyboard/mouse; 0 = always

keepAwake.description: Keep the computer from sleeping while it runs a job for someone; default on

serveModels.description: Serve the open AI models installed on this computer

name: bitpull_set_lending_rules
